title: Shared Memory (SHM) IPC Acceleration & Safe Native Engine Graceful Degradation
author: Brain Harness Autobiographical Reflection Engine (harness-reflector)
context: Passing large tool inputs and outputs (>64KB AST diffs, tabular datasets, repository maps) across subprocess pipes introduces JSON serialization and IPC buffer overhead, which can cause OS pipe deadlocks. In parallel, integrating native virtualization engines (like Wasmtime WASI runtimes) introduces platform dependency risks when host environments lack precompiled native wheels (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'wasmtime').
distilled_learning: # Shared Memory (SHM) IPC Acceleration & Safe Native Engine Graceful Degradation

claims.assertion: Handshake capability negotiation detects peer SHM support, routing large payloads (>64KB) through memory-mapped buffers with zero pipe copy.
Defensive atexit and _cleanup_all_shm unlinking prevents leaked OS shared memory blocks on proactor shutdown.
WasmSandboxExecutor transparently degrades to SubprocessExecutor when wasmtime module is absent or execution fails.
